subject: Re: POC success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Katie Moran <katie.moran@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff recap & immediate next steps

Hi Katie —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have aligned expectations before the formal statement of work. Highlights from our call: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood for search rerank + conversational product assistant on Acme mobile app (English, US). Primary success criteria: latency < 300ms 95th, sustain 50 TPS in peak scenario, quality comparable to current baseline (NDCG delta <= 3%), and cost < $0.004/token for generation.
- Data: You’ll provide a sample of 10k anonymized query-response pairs and the top-5 candidate lists for rerank.
- Duration: 4-week technical POC (2 weeks setup + 2 weeks load/quality evaluation).
- Ownership: Acme: Katie (product) + Tom (infra). Redwood: Jordan (sales/POC coordination) + Dev (integration lead).

Attached is a short POC plan and a KPI template to populate — I pasted the link as well in case of download issues. Could you confirm the timeline and who on your infra team will own the traffic generation for throughput tests?

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm dataset drop and infra contact by EOD Wednesday (5/31).
2) We schedule a 30-min kickoff for Thurs (6/3) or Fri (6/4) to walk the integration steps.
3) Dev will share the test harness and sample inference scripts once we have a dataset.

If those look good I’ll convert this into an MS SOW draft and proposed ring-fenced capacity for the trial.

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap & immediate next steps

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Katie. I’ll lock the kickoff for Fri 6/4 10am PT and send a calendar invite.

To be explicit on the evaluation plan and KPIs so your team can validate internally:

Evaluation plan (proposed):
- Week 0 (setup, days 1–3): secure bucket access, baseline data ingest, sandbox model deployment (small scale)
- Week 1 (integration, days 4–10): integration of rerank pipeline + conversational endpoint, functional validation vs. sample queries
- Week 2 (load & latency, days 11–17): run traffic-shaped load tests to measure 95th latency, p50/p95/p99, and max sustainable TPS.
- Week 3 (quality & cost, days 18–24): run quality evals on your held-out sets (NDCG, MRR) and estimate cost/token under observed throughput; generate a short report.
- Week 4 (wrap & review, days 25–28): final report, hand-off, and optional canary plan for pilot.

Primary KPIs we’ll measure (fill in numbers in the attached template):
- Latency: p50 / p95 / p99 for gen and rerank pathways (ms)
- Throughput: sustained TPS and max sustainable TPS under SLOs
- Cost: estimated $/token for generation flows and $/request for rerank (include pre/post-tokenization costs)
- Quality: NDCG@10, MRR, and a manual qualitative pass on 100 sampled dialogs (pass/fail on business-critical intents)

Pass/fail criteria (example):
- Latency: p95 <= 300ms for gen; rerank p95 <= 150ms
- Throughput: sustain 50 TPS for gen during peak window; rerank scale to 200 qps (since rerank is cheaper)
- Cost: gen <$0.004/token average across test window OR within 20% of projected budget
- Quality: NDCG delta <= 3% vs incumbent, no critical intent regressions found in manual review

Dev will reach out with the test harness and a short README ahead of kickoff. If you want, we can also set up a shared doc for live KPI reporting during the trial.

Jordan
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: prep for Acme POC (traffic profiles + infra checklist)

Team —

I’m prepping the test harness and want to confirm a few infra details before the kickoff: 

1) Traffic profile: Katie said the peak 1-min QPS maps to ~50 TPS for gen. Can Laura/Marissa confirm the synthetic shape (percentile distribution) we should emulate? I’ll provide load scripts for Locust + k6.
2) Dataset format: ETA for the S3 drop is 6/1 — what format do we expect? CSV with columns (query, candidates_json, label)? If Acme provides candidate lists, we can run reranking locally.
3) Measurement hooks: we’ll publish per-request latency tags and token counts to Datadog. Need Acme to whitelist our egress IPs for metric collection.

FYI I’ll include a short README and the initial harness in the shared Drive link by EOD 6/2.

—Dev
Principal Systems Engineer — Redwood Inference

- Traffic: Tom confirmed he can run the Locust profile Dev shares; he’s ok with the 50 TPS peak and will run a 24-hour soak on Day 3 of load testing.

We’re all set for the kickoff on Fri 6/4 10am PT. We’ll populate the KPI template this week so you have baseline numbers for pass/fail. Looking forward to it.
